purpose: Corporate identifiers used for GLM and MiMo across the historical leaderboard charts and table.

glm.adaptation: Retain the exact three official geometric Z paths, omit Chinese wordmark paths, apply one uniform scale and translation to center inside a 24x24 square. No logo path is redrawn.

mimo.adaptation: Embed official header paths with explicit translate(-112 0), corresponding to the 112px viewBox default non-hover state; remove animation and external CSS dependency.

rights: Company names and marks belong to their respective owners. No open-source license grant for the corporate marks is asserted.
